notes.title: Casual Desktop Game Update 2025
notes.content:
Hey fellow desktop destroyers!

I am with great pleasure to announce that the big update of Casual Desktop Game for 2025 is now ready and published!

I know that I originally wanted to wait for 14th of February, but this update is too big and important to postpone when it is already ready!

So, that's why I've published the update just now!

First of all I want to thank everyone who has been so supportive of this small retro project. I am aware of all the nice people upvoting any news I post, commenting on news I post and simply just playing the game!

The game wouldn't be where it is now with all you guys! You have kept me motivated to improve the game and thus I am pleased to provide you with the update 2025! You deserve this great update! Take it as a christmas gift. ;-)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34138261/ed01acf81b17114f413ddbeddeb86413d391e7e4.jpg[/img]

Now what has actually changed?

[list]
[*]Fireworks tool was greatly improved! It's now a damageable tool and creates huge varying explosions!
[*]New stamps! Finally I found some stamps with permissive licenses, so please enjoy them!
[*]New colorgun decals! Enjoy the improved color decals of the colorgun
[*]My own workshop items are now included in the game by default
[*]Hit indicators! Combat entities will now display a hit indicator when taking damage
[*]More teams! There are now up to 3 possible teams available
[*]Windowed fullscreen! The game won't hang when you accidentally move your cursor out of just leave focus of the game
[*]More different sounds and explosions
[*]Default backgrounds! Check out the included background images
[*]Bugfixes and improvements
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34138261/a1261f02670f59f24c1cb199aadc67d7eeadfaa1.jpg[/img]

I hope you'll have much fun with this new update! I hope you'll like it and please report if anything doesn't work as expected.

I wish you a merry christmas and a happy new year! I'm looking forward for the next 5 years and let's see what great things are to come for the 10 year anniversary. <3

notes.title: Friday Update
notes.content:
Hey guys,

Major update are two new tools: The helicopter and the sniper.

The Helicopter is a combat entity. You can control it around and it can be spawned into team 1 or team 2 like any other combat entity. It shoots volleys of three rockets against their opponents.

The sniper is a weapon tool which is just an addition to the other weapons like mp5, pistol or color gun.

Kind regards

notes.title: Version 1.0 released!
notes.content:
Hey guys!

Today I have released version 1.0 of Casual Desktop Game. I am sorry for the long inactivity, but I had much to do with other projects.

Some users wanted to let the combat entities move to a specified destination. So, yeah, now you can select multiple entities and point them to where they shall move. This applies for the tc_* tanks, the soldier and the laser mech. This way you can setup armies and let them attack each other. In order to select an entity simply hold the CTRL key and then click on an entity (you can see if an entity is clickable via a pointing cursor that appears then).

Also in one of the let's play videos on youtube someone intuitively pressed exit for opening the menu and then the game did exit. This was very frustrating for the player so he gave up on it. That's why there is now a confirmation box when pressing exit which also hints to hit the menu key for the menu. The confirmation box can be disabled if desired.

The headcrabs where so defensless that they do now attack nearby entities. Funny to have a swarm attack some soldiers. :D 

You can now also place your image files in the backgrounds folder. They can then be set as background via the ingame menu. This is useful if you don't only want to use your Desktop as background.

Also a new combat vehicle has been added: The rlauncher. It throws rockets at opponents.
Plus a new wand: The boltwand. It throws a lightning strike.

Last but not least there is a new weapon: a simple pistol.

CAUTION: There have been made changes to the interface for entities, so every old tool that uses the IScriptedEntity interface is now deprecated and cannot be loaded again. You have to add three methods to your entity class which are used to manage the movement command.
These are:
[list]
[*]bool IsMovable(): Indicate whether an entity can be moved by the player
[*]Vector& GetSelectionSize(): Return a vector which defines the size of the selection box that is drawed on a selected entity
[*]void MoveTo(const Vector& in vec): Called when passing the destination vector for the movement
[/list]
My own workshop items have been moved to the official depot. I will stick to providing future official tools with game updates. The workshop is then intended to be used by the community for custom tools.

Changelog
[list]
[*]Changed license to MIT
[*]Adjustable exit confirmation
[*]Upgrade project to MSVC++ 2019
[*]Entities can now be pointed to a target destination
[*]tc_light, tc_heavy, tc_dualgun, soldier and lasermech are now movable by user
[*]headcrab does now attack opponents
[*]New tool 'pistol'
[*]New tool 'rlauncher'
[*]New tool 'boltwand'
[*]Added scripting documentation
[*]You can now use different backgrounds via the ingame menu
[*]Added logging
[*]Services config
[*]Bugfixes
[/list]

Have fun playing & coding!

Kind regards

notes.title: Workshop is now set live!
notes.content:

notes.title: Update released!
notes.content:
[h1]Update has been released[/h1]

Thank you for all the provided feedback. I greatly appreciate it and thus I have released a first major update. Not everything has been done yet, but a nice amount of updates have been implemented, though. I hope you like it. If you have any feedback, please let me know.

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug that empty tool could be selected
[*]Fixed performance issues
[*]Fixed scrollbar showing if no further content
[*]Fixed static key usage of team toggle in team scripts
[*]Headcrabs now teleport to opposite instead of getting removed
[*]Fixed Lasermech shooting at nuke
[*]Fixed drawing of sprite trail of Fireworks tool
[*]Changed explosion sounds of tc_dualgun and tc_heavy
[*]New sound for aircraft and fixed volume
[*]Crosshair for mp5 and colorgun
[/list]

Have fun!
